about: What the scenario of a soft figure in a steamer basket is built around. The model asks for one reference named 'dumpling'. Tests make the stand-in below themselves. Real files are other people's designs, so neither they nor anything about them is in the repository: tests use them only when HOTEND_REFS_DIR points at a folder that holds them and their list (tests/local_references.py).

stand_in.note: A pleated dome written from a formula, 63.9 x 64.7 x 46 mm. The sizes are invented: no object was measured for them and it is nobody's model.
